# Guanzhi 官制 - 唐代爵位册封效果. root=受封者(菜单内 scope:recipient 调用)
# 纯 trait+旗标, 不建头衔: 有地者经整合包风味值覆盖挂载, 无头衔者经 gzfv_titleless 挂载
# 爵级由角色变量 guanzhi_tj_rank 传入 (9750 爵级菜单设定)

# 册封齐之爵 (guo级)
guanzhi_tangjue_grant_guo_0000 = {
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue grant effect entered"
	guanzhi_clear_tangjue_effect = yes
	scope:recipient = {
		# 地名旗标(驱动挂载 custom loc); 风味旗标仅无地者(有地者的整合包风味不能被压)
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tj_guo_0000
		if = {
			limit = { is_landed = no }
			add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjf_guo_0000
		}
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjholder
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 1 }
			add_trait = tj_guogong
			add_trait = tj_yi_3000
		}
		remove_variable = guanzhi_tj_rank
		guanzhi_fix_titleless_nickname_effect = yes
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue granted"
}

	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue grant effect entered"
	guanzhi_clear_tangjue_effect = yes
	scope:recipient = {
		# 地名旗标(驱动挂载 custom loc); 风味旗标仅无地者(有地者的整合包风味不能被压)
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tj_xian_0367
		if = {
			limit = { is_landed = no }
			add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjf_xian_0367
		}
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjholder
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 3 }
			add_trait = tj_xiangong
			add_trait = tj_yi_1500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 4 }
			add_trait = tj_xianhou
			add_trait = tj_yi_1000
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 5 }
			add_trait = tj_xianbo
			add_trait = tj_yi_700
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 6 }
			add_trait = tj_xianzi
			add_trait = tj_yi_500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 7 }
			add_trait = tj_xiannan
			add_trait = tj_yi_300
		}
		remove_variable = guanzhi_tj_rank
		guanzhi_fix_titleless_nickname_effect = yes
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue granted"
}

	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue grant effect entered"
	guanzhi_clear_tangjue_effect = yes
	scope:recipient = {
		# 地名旗标(驱动挂载 custom loc); 风味旗标仅无地者(有地者的整合包风味不能被压)
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tj_xian_0653
		if = {
			limit = { is_landed = no }
			add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjf_xian_0653
		}
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjholder
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 3 }
			add_trait = tj_xiangong
			add_trait = tj_yi_1500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 4 }
			add_trait = tj_xianhou
			add_trait = tj_yi_1000
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 5 }
			add_trait = tj_xianbo
			add_trait = tj_yi_700
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 6 }
			add_trait = tj_xianzi
			add_trait = tj_yi_500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 7 }
			add_trait = tj_xiannan
			add_trait = tj_yi_300
		}
		remove_variable = guanzhi_tj_rank
		guanzhi_fix_titleless_nickname_effect = yes
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue granted"
}

	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue grant effect entered"
	guanzhi_clear_tangjue_effect = yes
	scope:recipient = {
		# 地名旗标(驱动挂载 custom loc); 风味旗标仅无地者(有地者的整合包风味不能被压)
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tj_xian_0721
		if = {
			limit = { is_landed = no }
			add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjf_xian_0721
		}
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjholder
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 3 }
			add_trait = tj_xiangong
			add_trait = tj_yi_1500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 4 }
			add_trait = tj_xianhou
			add_trait = tj_yi_1000
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 5 }
			add_trait = tj_xianbo
			add_trait = tj_yi_700
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 6 }
			add_trait = tj_xianzi
			add_trait = tj_yi_500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 7 }
			add_trait = tj_xiannan
			add_trait = tj_yi_300
		}
		remove_variable = guanzhi_tj_rank
		guanzhi_fix_titleless_nickname_effect = yes
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue granted"
}

	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue grant effect entered"
	guanzhi_clear_tangjue_effect = yes
	scope:recipient = {
		# 地名旗标(驱动挂载 custom loc); 风味旗标仅无地者(有地者的整合包风味不能被压)
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tj_xian_0966
		if = {
			limit = { is_landed = no }
			add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjf_xian_0966
		}
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_tjholder
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 3 }
			add_trait = tj_xiangong
			add_trait = tj_yi_1500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 4 }
			add_trait = tj_xianhou
			add_trait = tj_yi_1000
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 5 }
			add_trait = tj_xianbo
			add_trait = tj_yi_700
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 6 }
			add_trait = tj_xianzi
			add_trait = tj_yi_500
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:guanzhi_tj_rank = 7 }
			add_trait = tj_xiannan
			add_trait = tj_yi_300
		}
		remove_variable = guanzhi_tj_rank
		guanzhi_fix_titleless_nickname_effect = yes
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI tangjue granted"
}
